about: Hand-kept list of dated events for the 2-week Catalyst Calendar. Times in UTC (8:30 AM ET = 13:30 UTC, 2:00 PM ET = 19:00 UTC in winter). allday = no set time. end = last day of a multi-day event. est = date expected, not yet confirmed. impact: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high. cat: econ, fed, earnings, politics, world, markets, fyi. find = word-sets that pick each site's own market for the event (a title must hold every word of one set; the market settling closest to the event wins). not = words that rule a market out. keys = words that link an event to prediction markets (empty = no market link). Sources: BLS, BEA, Census, federalreserve.gov, company IR pages, UNFCCC, APEC, OPEC, state election offices. Add new events monthly.

events.name: Full Beaver supermoon
events.note: Last full moon before Thanksgiving. Trading folklore says full moons bring volatility; no proof, but people talk about it.

events.name: Consumer confidence (Nov)
events.note: Conference Board survey, 10 AM ET. Came in at 103.3, up from 91.9.

events.name: GDP (Q3, 2nd estimate) + PCE inflation (Oct)
events.note: Growth plus the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, on one morning. Last big data before December's Fed meeting.

events.name: Durable goods orders (Oct)
events.note: Factory orders for long-lasting goods; a read on business investment.

events.name: Weekly jobless claims (week to Nov 21)
events.note: Moved to Wednesday for Thanksgiving. Kalshi lists a market on the number.

events.name: New home sales (Oct)
events.note: Sales of newly built homes, 10 AM ET.

events.name: Fed Beige Book
events.note: Fed's district-by-district survey of the economy.

events.name: Thanksgiving: US markets closed
events.note: Holiday week means thin trading. Prices can jump on small orders, on every site.

events.name: Black Friday: stocks close at 1 PM ET
events.note: Shortened session. Holiday-sales numbers start to come in over the weekend.

events.name: OPEC+ monthly meeting (8-country group)
events.note: Saudi Arabia, Russia and five others decide January oil output. Moves oil and gas-price markets.

events.name: Georgia runoffs (state House District 151, local)
events.note: Small runoffs only: Georgia House District 151 and a Savannah-Chatham school board seat. No statewide or congressional race.

events.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI (Nov)
events.note: Factory survey, 10 AM ET. Above 50 means growth.

events.name: Job openings, JOLTS (Oct)
events.note: Job openings and quits, 10 AM ET. Watched for cooling in the labour market.

events.name: CrowdStrike and Marvell earnings
events.note: After the close. Marvell's date is expected, not yet confirmed; CrowdStrike's is confirmed.

events.name: ADP private payrolls (Nov)
events.note: ADP's private-sector jobs count, 8:15 AM ET, two days before the official jobs report.

events.name: Spotify Wrapped 2026
events.note: Spotify's year-end lists drop, usually on a Wednesday in early December. Top-album and top-artist markets settle on them.

events.name: Salesforce earnings
events.note: After the close. Date expected, not yet confirmed by the company.

events.name: Weekly jobless claims (week to Nov 28)
events.note: First-time unemployment claims, 8:30 AM ET.

events.name: Google Year in Search 2026
events.note: Google's list of the year's top trending searches, usually out in the first week of December. Settles the most-searched-person markets.

events.name: ISM Services PMI (Nov)
events.note: Survey of the service sector, most of the US economy. 10 AM ET.

events.name: Jobs report (Nov)
events.note: Payrolls and unemployment rate. The biggest monthly data release.

events.name: Consumer sentiment, preliminary (Dec)
events.note: University of Michigan survey, 10 AM ET. Includes inflation expectations.

events.name: Golden Globe nominations
events.note: Nominations for the 84th Golden Globes are announced at 5 AM PT. The awards follow on Jan 10, 2027; winner markets move on today's list.

events.name: Trade balance (Oct)
events.note: US imports and exports; moves with tariffs.

events.name: Existing home sales (Nov)
events.note: NAR's count of previously owned homes sold, 10 AM ET.

events.name: Fed rate decision
events.note: Rate decision plus new projections and a press conference.

events.name: Adobe earnings
events.note: After the close. Date expected, not yet confirmed by the company.

events.name: TIME Person of the Year
events.note: TIME names its Person of the Year, usually on a Thursday in the second week of December (Dec 11 last year). One of the busiest culture markets of the year.

events.name: CPI inflation report (Nov)

events.name: Weekly jobless claims (week to Dec 5)
events.note: First-time unemployment claims, 8:30 AM ET, same time as CPI.

events.name: Lutnick testifies to Senate Banking (Megaspeed, AI chip exports)
events.note: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick appears before the Senate Banking Committee over the Megaspeed / Nvidia chip-export scandal. Markets on whether he leaves office react to it. Our Dossier: alphainteldesk.com/dossier/howard-lutnick.html

events.name: Broadcom earnings

events.name: Costco earnings

events.name: Government funding deadline
events.note: Current funding runs out. Without a new bill, a shutdown starts Dec 12.

events.name: Louisiana runoffs: US House districts 5 and 6
events.note: Two US House seats with no majority on Nov 3 are decided today, under the new map drawn after the Supreme Court's April ruling.

events.name: Oracle earnings

events.name: ECB rate decision

events.name: Weekly jobless claims (week to Dec 12)

events.name: Christmas Eve: stocks close at 1 PM ET
